title: Everyday Phrases — At the Juice Bar
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🥤 實用果汁店必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Juice Bar
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用果汁店情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Juice Bar phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your place feels like home now.
dialogue.zh: 你這裡現在讓我覺得像家一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what's new on the menu?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這個綠色的叫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Juice is thin, smoothies are thick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那代表更多膳食纖維，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which drink fills me up fastest?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you squeeze every orange here?
dialogue.zh: 你們每顆柳橙都現榨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每一杯都是每天早晨現榨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 從不，這是我們唯一的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel sleepy, need some energy.
dialogue.zh: 我有點睏，需要補充能量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那試試我們的芒果能量飲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What makes Mango Boost so strong?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 芒果、香蕉和真正的燕麥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It makes it creamy, trust me.
dialogue.zh: 會讓口感更綿密，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does any energy drink have coffee?
dialogue.zh: 提神飲品裡有含咖啡的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 空腹喝咖啡會讓我不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then skip it, fruit is better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm tired lately, what wakes me?
dialogue.zh: 我最近好累，喝什麼會清醒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ginger? Will that taste too hot?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that warm feeling, okay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But is that one very sweet?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have to watch my sugar.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go low sugar, we can help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which drinks are lowest in sugar?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is watermelon on the list?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼西瓜也在名單上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Melon has more water than sugar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 但那不會嘗起來很淡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the berry blend have added sugar?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈbɛri blɛnd hæv ˈædəd ˈʃʊɡɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 莓果冰沙有額外加糖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒加糖，只用熟透的莓果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 熟透的莓果就已經夠甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，大自然都幫你弄好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many calories are in it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，這是我們最輕盈的冰沙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My doctor says cut back on sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdɑktɚ sɛz kʌt bæk ɑn ˈʃʊɡɚ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So greens and melon for you.
dialogue.zh: 那你就選綠葉和蜜瓜吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, are you allergic to them?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the berry blend contain strawberry?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 藍莓冰沙完全不放草莓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 安全，它們跟草莓不是一種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 堅果過敏嗎？我們會看標示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 樹堅果也會讓我不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep all nuts out here.
dialogue.zh: 我們店裡完全不進堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們店裡安全永遠第一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以完全不碰奶製品嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，牛奶、燕麥奶還是豆漿？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is everything washed with clean water?
dialogue.zh: 水果都是用乾淨的水洗的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you clean the blender daily?
dialogue.zh: 果汁機你們每天清洗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們每做一杯就洗一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 很棒，我在你這裡喝得很安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That trust matters most to us.
dialogue.zh: 這份信任對我們最重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one Citrus Kick as well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's one for me, one to go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wʌn fɚ mi, wʌn tu ɡoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll note that on the cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你記得我們所有的喜好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 熟客就是這家店最美好的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and maybe change the base.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How sweet is the normal one?
dialogue.zh: 先問問，一般甜度有多甜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 中等，大約半根香蕉的甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you skip the sugar entirely?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so we'll leave it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife likes lots of ice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More fruit in mine, less apple.
dialogue.zh: 我的多放水果，少放蘋果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, a small slice only.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那是果汁，本來就不用奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add coconut water to juice?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æd ˈkoʊkəˌnʌt ˈwɔtɚ tu dʒus?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要加一匙香草蛋白粉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the protein extra?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 膠原蛋白加進果汁沒味道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you add water to juice?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you write the notes down?
dialogue.zh: 這些要求都記下來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 快寫完了，你叫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add my phone number?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's five five five, double eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you get the number right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you keep my info safe?
dialogue.zh: 你們會保護我的資料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half sweet, light ice, soy base.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I mention the oat milk?
dialogue.zh: 我之前有提到燕麥奶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你這訂單做起來真有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you blend with the peel?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 果肉多的果汁，經典選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One lemon slice on the side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make hers cold, but not frozen.
dialogue.zh: 她那杯要冰但別打成冰塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra ice, but not blended hard.
dialogue.zh: 另外加冰，但不往死裡打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們倆講的是一種語言。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今天我還有什麼不能點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只有莓果那杯，記得原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best seat is at the bar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我愛看你們手腳俐落的樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does forty in an hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty? I thought it was ten.
dialogue.zh: 四十顆？我以為只有十顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No wonder the flavor is deep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that slow for a smoothie?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you cut everything by hand?
dialogue.zh: 你們都是手工切水果嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是我們見過最大的一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the ginger root?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you get the fruit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A farm an hour from here.
dialogue.zh: 一家農場，離這兒一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains how sweet they are.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is your large cup?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small or medium? I can't decide.
dialogue.zh: 小杯還是中杯？我猶豫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A large juice is six fifty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 七塊五，加稅也還能接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any combo deals?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay with my card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I become a member?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell a prepaid card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, add any amount you like.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay by phone, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen fifty with tax, tap here.
dialogue.zh: 十四塊五含稅，這裡感應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 科技是我們最好的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get a paper receipt?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們居然已經有我的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 果汁機的聲音聽了很療癒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the green just turn bright?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個味道真的是芹菜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No celery smell in mine, right?
dialogue.zh: 我那杯不會有芹菜味吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your cup is almost ready now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was me, drinks are ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the green one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I taste it right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, this is just fresh greens.
dialogue.zh: 好，這杯純粹是蔬果鮮甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half sweet, exactly how you asked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How's the one for my wife?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my cup filled to the top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ kʌp fɪld tu ðə tɑp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get a free straw?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you seal it for takeout?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it here, not the lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以拿幾張餐巾紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take three, they're by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a bag for both?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə bæɡ fɚ boʊθ?/
dialogue.zh: 能給我一個提袋裝兩杯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to tip you?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I still change my order?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 還來得及，她那杯還沒封口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 對了，她那杯附一點蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and that's free of charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I owe you anything more?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我傳訊息給她，她就在附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My drink is separating a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh juice always does this, right?
dialogue.zh: 新鮮果汁都會這樣，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell that to the farm, too.
dialogue.zh: 這句話也替我誇誇農場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her cup has extra orange today.
dialogue.zh: 她那杯今天多加了柳橙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We see her twice a week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 明天還有同樣的優惠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half off? What time do you open?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɔf? wʌt taɪm du ju ˈoʊpən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我幫你留那個安靜的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I order ahead by text?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text ahead, I'll blend it fresh.
dialogue.zh: 你先傳訊息，我現打現做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring my cousin tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New friends get a free sample.
dialogue.zh: 新朋友都能試喝免費杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll thank you for that tip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring her, I'll make her a fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ hɜr, aɪl meɪk hɜr ə fæn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I recommend you on my page?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ju ɑn maɪ peɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我能在粉絲團上推薦你們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, it helps us grow.
dialogue.zh: 拜託寫一篇，對我們有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Group orders get big cups free.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring ten, I'll blend for all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them the juice bar sends love.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ðɛm ðə dʒus bɑr sɛndz lʌv./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They'll ask where I learned this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it came from taste tests.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you call the fruit of the week?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ju kɔl ðə frut əv ðə wik?/
dialogue.zh: 這週的水果主打叫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet, pink, and totally low sugar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife would love that pink.
dialogue.zh: 我太太會愛那個粉紅色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你的豆漿綠拿鐵在等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop is dull without you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wave at you through the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl weɪv æt ju θru ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bye for now, best juice crew.
dialogue.zh: 先走了，最棒的果汁團隊。
